thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: elevated 5xx rate detected for route `/v1/generate` (region: us-west1). Paging on-call: @sara oncall. Impact: ~40% of requests returning 502/504 since 08:12 UTC. :rotating_light:

sara oncall: I got the page, joining. Can someone drop correlation IDs and a quick symptom summary?

mike infra: Sending recent gateway logs for the time window 08:10-08:20 UTC. Noticed a spike in `gateway->upstream` timeout errors and a lot of downstream retries.

mike infra: ```
2026-03-15T08:11:02Z gateway request_id=rid=abc123 cor_id=cid-9a1 502 upstream=10.2.4.12:504  elapsed=3001ms retry=1
2026-03-15T08:11:04Z gateway request_id=rid=abc124 cor_id=cid-9b2 504 upstream_timeout elapsed=6000ms retry=2
2026-03-15T08:12:08Z gateway request_id=rid=abc146 cor_id=cid-9c3 502 upstream=10.2.4.14 KVCacheMiss=true
```

jamal eng-sre: Those look like upstream worker timeouts. Are the model workers overloaded or did the routing change?

sara oncall: @dinesh can you check model-worker pool health and any recent deploys?

dinesh eng-runtime: No user-facing deploys in last 2 hours. Model pool pod restarts spiked around 08:10 on one node: `model-worker-7` restarted 6 times in 2m. Possibly OOM or GPU driver crash. Logs: ```
[2026-03-15T08:09:58Z] model-worker-7 ERROR: OutOfMemoryError: Alloc failed for tensor 4096x4096
[2026-03-15T08:10:04Z] kubelet: container restartCount=1
[2026-03-15T08:10:30Z] model-worker-7 ERROR: nvml: device lost
```

nina prod: Impacted customers seen: 3 big customers with high traffic patterns (chat threads, streaming). Support reporting timeouts and partial responses. Eva, can you pull customer-visible errors?

eva support: Customer tickets show `502: upstream request failed` and `timeout while waiting for response`. One customer on dedicated capacity saw 30% failure rate for 08:10-08:18. Provided correlation IDs: cid-9a1, cid-9b2, cid-9c3.

jamal eng-sre: Hypothesis list (meeting thread):
1) model-worker OOMs causing immediate upstream connection drops -> 502/504.
2) gateway retry amplification: gateway retries multiple times, saturating upstream pool and causing cascading failures.
3) network flakiness between gateway and workers (less likely given OOM evidence).

sara oncall: Agreed. Immediate mitigations: (A) reduce gateway retry attempts to 0 for `/v1/generate` to avoid amplification, (B) scale up model-worker pool + cordon node with repeated restarts, (C) enable fallback routing to a smaller quantized model instance for heavy customers. Who can action each?

mike infra: I can flip the retry config in the gateway feature flag to `retries=0` now. Doing a quick rollout to us-west1 only. Will monitor.

dinesh eng-runtime: I'll scale model-worker pool + taint node `gpunode-9` that had the OOMs. Scaling +1 replicas and adding tolerations for redistribution. Also grabbing core dumps.

sara oncall: @mike infra do it carefully; we want to avoid losing more capacity during the rollout. Post a small canary.

mike infra: Canary started at 08:14:12 UTC, sending 5% traffic. Observing error rate fall from 42% -> 18% in the canary. Rolling to full region at 08:15:00.

jamal eng-sre: After retries=0, logs show fewer upstream concurrent connections per request and error storm reduced. But still seeing worker restarts. Need to collect timeline.

mike infra: Updated gateway logs after config change: ```
2026-03-15T08:14:15Z gateway rid=abc200 cor_id=cid-9d4 200 upstream=10.2.4.21 elapsed=120ms
2026-03-15T08:14:16Z gateway rid=abc201 cor_id=cid-9d5 502 upstream=10.2.4.15 elapsed=3050ms retry=0
```

eva support: Customer impact note for postmortem: starting 08:11 UTC high-severity errors, degraded for ~12 minutes, partial mitigation applied at 08:14, residual errors until 08:18. Affected customers: 3 paying customers, 1 trial org. No data-exfil or integrity issues reported.

jamal eng-sre: Collecting correlation-id timeline. We should attach these to the incident timeline: cid-9a1 (502 @08:11:02), cid-9b2 (504 @08:11:04), cid-9c3 (502 @08:12:08), cid-9d4 (200 @08:14:15 after mitigation).

sara oncall: Good. Next steps: (1) full node forensic on gpunode-9 (dinesh), (2) analyze model memory growth / input size for those requests (jamal+dinesh), (3) decide on automatic circuit breaker to avoid gateway amplification (product + eng). Nina/Eva prepare customer comms draft. I'll stay on for handoff until postmortem doc created.

dinesh eng-runtime: Forensic logs saved: /mnt/forensics/gpunode-9/2026-03-15/core-*. Tarballing now. Noted `nvml: device lost` and repeated CUDA OOM. Looking into batch size/sequence-length distribution.

jamal eng-sre: Also flagging that a recent model variant rollout (quantized-v2) was added to the routing table 07:58 UTC but traffic split was low; unlikely root cause but we should verify memory profile differences between variants.

mike infra: Observed one suspicious spike in long sequences from one customer session at 08:09:45 — very large prompt -> memory blowup. Correlation id cid-9a0. We'll attach request payload (sanitized) to the postmortem.

sara oncall: Thanks all. I'll create the incident doc (INC-2026-03-15-5xx) and add the timeline + actions. Handoff to jamal for owner of RCA. Please add logs and timelines to the doc.

jamal eng-sre: I'll take RCA owner. Quick notes: root cause likely model-worker memory exhaustion on gpunode-9 triggered by a large prompt combined with gateway retry amplification. Mitigations executed: retries=0 at 08:14, scale +1 replicas and cordon node at 08:15, fallback routing to quantized model for heavy customers at 08:16.

eva support: I'll send customer ACKs now, include mitigation summary and ETA for full postmortem.

sara oncall: Closing timely mitigation. Will follow-up with postmortem draft and long-term actions: circuit-breaker, worker-side request size limits, and improved observability (per-request GPU memory metrics).

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: status=mitigated severity=partial mitigation_ts=1779003240 (08:16 UTC) assigned=jamal eng-sre

jamal eng-sre: Adding hypothesis tracking items to the RCA doc: [H1] OOM from large inputs (high confidence), [H2] retry amplification (medium confidence), [H3] GPU driver flakiness (low confidence). We'll close H2 after implementing retry circuit breakers.

sara oncall: Thanks team. If no more actions, I'll hand this off to jamal and sign out. :white_check_mark:

mike infra: Leaving a note for postmortem: include diff of gateway retry config, worker restart histograms, and per-customer request size percentiles.

jamal eng-sre: I'll schedule RCA sync tomorrow 09:30 UTC. Everyone add any logs/correlations to the incident doc.
